lessons.title: Understanding Multiplication
lessons.description: Understand multiplication as groups of equal objects, repeated addition, and grid arrays. Describe real-world multiplication contexts.

lessons.title: Multiplication on a Number Line
lessons.description: Represent multiplication problems on a number line. Model jumps of equal sizes to calculate products.

lessons.title: Commutative & Associative Properties
lessons.description: Understand commutative (a × b = b × a) and associative properties of multiplication to multiply single-digit numbers.

lessons.title: Understanding Division
lessons.description: Understand division as sharing equally and partition grouping. Interpret quotients as shares or groups.

lessons.title: Multiplication & Division Relationships
lessons.description: Explore the relationship between multiplication and division as inverse operations. Find the missing factor in division families.

lessons.title: Facts for 2s, 5s, and 10s
lessons.description: Develop speed and fluency with multiplication and division facts of 2s, 5s, and 10s using patterns and skip counting.

lessons.title: Facts for 3s, 4s, and 6s
lessons.description: Learn and practice multiplication and division facts for 3s, 4s, and 6s. Develop computational automaticity.

lessons.title: Facts for 7s, 8s, and 9s
lessons.description: Learn and practice multiplication and division facts for 7s, 8s, and 9s. Apply properties and tricks to aid facts recall.

lessons.title: Two-Step Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve two-step word problems involving all four operations. Represent problems with equations and check solutions for reasonableness.

lessons.title: Identifying Arithmetic Patterns
lessons.description: Identify arithmetic patterns in multiplication tables and addition charts. Use mathematical properties to explain patterns.

lessons.title: Rounding Whole Numbers
lessons.description: Round whole numbers to the nearest 10 or 100 using place value understanding. Apply rounding in real-world estimation.

lessons.title: Addition & Subtraction within 1000
lessons.description: Fluently add and subtract whole numbers within 1000 using strategies based on place value, properties, and algorithms.

lessons.title: Multiplying by Multiples of 10
lessons.description: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of 10 (e.g., 9 × 80) using place value understanding and patterns.

lessons.title: Fractions as Parts of a Whole
lessons.description: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts. Represent parts of a whole.

lessons.title: Fractions on a Number Line
lessons.description: Represent fractions on a number line diagram. Identify unit fraction intervals and plot numbers between 0 and 1.

lessons.title: Equivalent Fractions
lessons.description: Understand fraction equivalence and identify equivalent fractions. Represent whole numbers as fractions (e.g., 3 = 3/1).

lessons.title: Comparing Fractions
lessons.description: Compare two fractions with the same numerator or same denominator using area models, number lines, and comparisons (<, >, =).

lessons.title: Telling Time & Elapsed Time
lessons.description: Tell and write time to the nearest minute. Measure elapsed time intervals in minutes. Solve real-world word problems.

lessons.title: Measuring Liquid Volume & Mass
lessons.description: Measure and estimate liquid volumes (liters) and masses (grams, kilograms). Solve word problems using addition and subtraction.

lessons.title: Picture Graphs & Bar Graphs
lessons.description: Draw scaled picture graphs and scaled bar graphs to represent a data set. Solve "how many more" and "how many less" problems.

lessons.title: Measurement Data on Line Plots
lessons.description: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths using rulers marked with halves and fourths of an inch. Show data on line plots.

lessons.title: Understanding Area & Unit Squares
lessons.description: Recognize area as an attribute of plane figures and understand concepts of area measurement. Measure area by counting unit squares.

lessons.title: Area of Rectangles & Decomposing
lessons.description: Relate area to multiplication. Solve real-world area problems for rectangles, apply distributive property, and decompose irregular shapes.

lessons.title: Perimeter & Area Relationships
lessons.description: Solve mathematical problems involving perimeters of polygons. Find perimeters given side lengths, find missing sides, and compare areas.

lessons.title: Shape Classes & Financial Literacy
lessons.description: Classify shapes by attributes (e.g., quadrilaterals). Partition shapes into parts with equal areas. Understand money, coins, and bills.

lessons.title: Comparison Word Problems
lessons.description: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (e.g., 35 = 5 × 7 means 35 is 5 times as many as 7). Solve word problems using multiplicative comparisons.

lessons.title: Multi-Step Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve multi-step word problems involving whole numbers and all four operations. Represent word problems using equations with a variable.

lessons.title: Patterns
lessons.description: Factors & Multiples
lessons.standard: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1--100. Recognize multiples of numbers and define prime vs.\ composite numbers.

lessons.title: Patterns
lessons.description: Generating Patterns
lessons.standard: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule (e.g., add 3). Analyze patterns to identify informal features.

lessons.title: Patterns
lessons.description: Equations & Unknowns
lessons.standard: Solve equations with variables for unknown numbers in multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction word contexts.

lessons.title: Place Value Structure
lessons.description: Recognize that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right. Read and write numbers.

lessons.title: Rounding & Comparing Numbers
lessons.description: Use place value understanding to round multi-digit whole numbers to any place. Compare large numbers using <, >, and =.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction
lessons.description: Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm. Solve real-world word problems.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Multiplication
lessons.description: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit whole number, and multiply two two-digit numbers. Illustrate with area models.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Division
lessons.description: Find whole-number quotients and remainders with up to four-digit dividends and one-digit divisors, using equations and rectangular arrays.

lessons.title: Equivalent Fractions
lessons.description: Explain fraction equivalence by using visual fraction models. Generate equivalent fractions by multiplying or dividing numerators and denominators.

lessons.title: Comparing Fractions
lessons.description: Compare two fractions with different numerators and different denominators by creating common denominators or comparing to benchmarks.

lessons.title: Adding & Subtracting Fractions
lessons.description: Understand addition and subtraction of fractions as joining and separating parts referring to the same whole. Add/subtract like fractions and mixed numbers.

lessons.title: Decomposing
lessons.description: Word Problems
lessons.standard: Decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way. Solve word problems with fraction addition/subtraction.

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions by Whole Numbers
lessons.description: Understand a fraction as a multiple of a unit fraction (e.g., 5/4 = 5 × 1/4). Multiply a fraction by a whole number in word problems.

lessons.title: Decimal Fractions
lessons.description: Express a fraction with denominator 10 as an equivalent fraction with denominator 100, and use this technique to add two fractions.

lessons.title: Decimal Notation & Comparison
lessons.description: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100. Compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size (<, >, =).

lessons.title: Measurement Size Relationships
lessons.description: Know relative sizes of measurement units (km, m, cm; kg, g; lb, oz; l, ml; hr, min, sec). Record measurement equivalents in a two-column table.

lessons.title: Measurement Word Problems
lessons.description: Use the four operations to solve word problems involving distances, intervals of time, liquid volumes, masses of objects, and money.

lessons.title: Area & Perimeter of Rectangles
lessons.description: Apply the area and perimeter formulas for rectangles in real-world and mathematical problems (e.g., finding width given area).

lessons.title: Line Plots with Fractions
lessons.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Solve addition/subtraction fraction problems.

lessons.title: Understanding Angle Measurement
lessons.description: Recognize angles as geometric shapes formed wherever two rays share a common endpoint. Understand concept of angle measurement in degrees.

lessons.title: Measuring & Adding Angles
lessons.description: Measure angles in degrees using a protractor. Sketch angles of specified measure. Solve addition/subtraction problems finding unknown angles.

lessons.title: Angles
lessons.description: Lines, Angles & Shape Symmetry
lessons.standard: Draw points, lines, line segments, rays, angles (right, acute, obtuse), and perpendicular and parallel lines. Identify line-symmetric shapes.

lessons.title: Angles
lessons.description: Classifying Shapes & Financial Literacy
lessons.standard: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines. Solve money problems including tax and change.

lessons.title: Writing & Evaluating Expressions
lessons.description: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions, and evaluate expressions. Write expressions that record calculations.

lessons.title: Generating Patterns & Graphing
lessons.description: Generate two numerical patterns using given rules (e.g., add 3, add 6). Identify relationships, form ordered pairs, and graph on coordinate grid.

lessons.title: Understanding Powers of 10
lessons.description: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times what it represents to its right, and 1/10 to its left. Use exponents.

lessons.title: Reading, Writing & Rounding Decimals
lessons.description: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form. Round decimals to any place.

lessons.title: Whole Number Multiplication
lessons.description: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm. Solve real-world word problems.

lessons.title: Whole Number Division
lessons.description: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using equations and rectangular arrays.

lessons.title: Adding & Subtracting Decimals
lessons.description: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths, using concrete models, place value strategies, and written properties.

lessons.title: Multiplying & Dividing Decimals
lessons.description: Multiply and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings. Relate strategies to a written method.

lessons.title: Adding & Subtracting Fractions
lessons.description: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with unlike denominators by replacing them with equivalent fractions with common denominators.

lessons.title: Fraction Addition/Subtraction Problems
lessons.description: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions referring to the same whole, using visual models and checking for reasonableness.

lessons.title: Fractions as Division Word Problems
lessons.description: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b). Solve word problems involving sharing whole items.

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions
lessons.description: Mixed Numbers
lessons.standard: Multiply fractions or mixed numbers. Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths. Interpret products as scaling.

lessons.title: Fraction Multiplication Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve real-world word problems involving multiplication of fractions and mixed numbers, using visual fraction models and equations.

lessons.title: Dividing Unit Fractions by Wholes
lessons.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of division to divide unit fractions by non-zero whole numbers (e.g., 1/3 ÷ 4).

lessons.title: Dividing Wholes by Unit Fractions
lessons.description: Apply and extend division understandings to divide whole numbers by unit fractions (e.g., 4 ÷ 1/3). Solve real-world fraction problems.

lessons.title: Measurement Conversions
lessons.description: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given measurement system (metric and customary). Solve multi-step problems.

lessons.title: Representing Data on Line Plots
lessons.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Solve problems using operations on fractions.

lessons.title: Understanding Volume
lessons.description: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures and understand concepts of volume measurement. Measure volume by counting unit cubes.

lessons.title: Volume of Rectangular Prisms
lessons.description: Relate volume to the operations of multiplication and addition. Find volume of rectangular prisms using V = lwh and V = Bh in word problems.

lessons.title: Volume of Composite Prisms
lessons.description: Find volume of solid figures composed of two non-overlapping right rectangular prisms by adding the volumes of the parts.

lessons.title: Coordinate Plane Intro
lessons.description: Understand coordinate plane concepts. Graph points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane with real number coordinates.

lessons.title: Graphing Real-World Problems
lessons.description: Represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant, and interpret coordinate values of points.

lessons.title: Properties of 2D Figures
lessons.description: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories (hierarchical mapping).

lessons.title: Classifying Shapes
lessons.description: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties. Group triangles and quadrilaterals based on angles and side relationships.

lessons.title: Cumulative Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve multi-step real-world word problems drawing on all domains: fractions, decimals, volume, coordinate graphing, and geometry.

lessons.description: Subtracting Rational Numbers
lessons.standard: Apply and extend understanding of addition and subtraction to rational numbers. Represent on a number line; interpret sums and differences in real-world contexts (temperature, elevation, debt).

lessons.title: Multiplying
lessons.description: Dividing Rational Numbers
lessons.standard: Apply and extend understanding of multiplication and division to rational numbers. Understand products and quotients of signed numbers; interpret rules for multiplying and dividing integers.

lessons.title: Four Operations with Rational Numbers
lessons.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving all four operations with rational numbers, including complex fractions and multi-step situations.

lessons.title: Unit 4: Algebraic Expressions
lessons.description: Linear Expressions with Rational Coefficients
lessons.standard: Apply properties of operations to add, subtract, factor, and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients. Understand how rewriting expressions reveals relationships (e.g., a + 0.05a = 1.05a).

lessons.title: Construction
lessons.description: Scale Drawings
lessons.standard: Solve problems involving scale drawings of geometric figures, including computing actual lengths and areas from a scale drawing and reproducing a drawing at a different scale.

lessons.title: Construction
lessons.description: Drawing Geometric Figures
lessons.standard: Draw geometric shapes with given conditions (triangles from three measures of angles or sides). Understand when conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one, or none.

lessons.title: Construction
lessons.description: Slicing 3D Figures
lessons.standard: Describe the two-dimensional figures that result from slicing three-dimensional figures (right rectangular prisms, right rectangular pyramids) parallel or perpendicular to the base.

lessons.title: Angles
lessons.description: Angle Relationships
lessons.standard: Use facts about supplementary, complementary, vertical, and adjacent angles to set up and solve simple equations for an unknown angle in a figure.

lessons.title: Unit 9: Probability
lessons.description: Introduction to Probability
lessons.standard: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1. Approximate probability through experiments; compare experimental to theoretical probability.

lessons.title: Unit 9: Probability
lessons.description: Probability Models
lessons.standard: Develop uniform and non-uniform probability models. Use models to find probabilities of events; compare predictions with observed frequencies and explain discrepancies.

lessons.title: Translations, Reflections & Rotations
lessons.description: Understand and apply translations, reflections, and rotations on the coordinate plane. Describe the effect of each rigid motion on coordinates and identify preserved properties (distance, angle measure).

lessons.title: Sequences of Transformations
lessons.description: Apply sequences of rigid motions to map one figure onto another. Understand that two figures are congruent if one can be obtained from the other by a sequence of rigid transformations; use this to identify congruent figures.

lessons.title: Angle Relationships & Parallel Lines
lessons.description: Use informal arguments and transformation reasoning to establish facts about angles formed when parallel lines are cut by a transversal (alternate interior, corresponding angles) and the angle-sum of triangles.

lessons.title: Dilations & Scale Factor
lessons.description: Understand dilations as transformations that scale figures from a center point by a scale factor. Identify the effect on coordinates and determine whether the image is larger, smaller, or congruent.

lessons.title: Similar Figures
lessons.description: Understand that two figures are similar if one can be obtained from the other by a sequence of rigid motions and a dilation. Use similarity to set up and solve proportions for unknown side lengths and angles.

lessons.title: Introducing Slope via Similar Triangles
lessons.description: Use similar triangles to explain why the slope m is the same between any two distinct points on a non-vertical line in the coordinate plane. Derive the equation y = mx for lines through the origin.

lessons.title: Slope
lessons.description: Graph proportional relationships; interpret the unit rate as the slope of the graph. Compare two proportional relationships represented in different ways (table, graph, equation, verbal).

lessons.title: Slope-Intercept Form y = mx + b
lessons.description: Derive y = mx + b as defining a linear function with slope m and y-intercept b. Interpret slope and intercept in real-world contexts; graph and write equations given two points or a point and slope.

lessons.title: Interpreting Linear Models
lessons.description: Construct a function to model a linear relationship between two quantities. Determine rate of change and initial value from descriptions, tables, graphs, and equations; interpret in context.

lessons.title: Solving Linear Equations in One Variable
lessons.description: Solve linear equations in one variable including cases with one solution, infinitely many solutions, or no solution. Recognize when an equation has each type of solution set; justify reasoning.

lessons.title: Systems of Equations: Graphing
lessons.description: Understand that a solution to a system of two linear equations is the point of intersection of their graphs. Solve systems graphically; interpret solutions in real-world contexts including no-solution and infinite-solution cases.

lessons.title: Systems of Equations: Substitution & Elimination
lessons.description: Solve systems of two linear equations algebraically using substitution and elimination (linear combinations). Estimate solutions by graphing and verify algebraically.

lessons.title: Understanding Functions
lessons.description: Understand that a function assigns exactly one output to each input. Represent functions using tables, graphs, and equations; determine whether a relation is a function. Distinguish linear from nonlinear functions.

lessons.title: Qualitative Graphs & Functional Relationships
lessons.description: Describe qualitatively the functional relationship between two quantities by analyzing a graph (e.g., where it is increasing, decreasing, linear, or nonlinear). Sketch a graph from a verbal description.

lessons.title: Volume of Cylinders, Cones & Spheres
lessons.description: Know and apply the formulas for volumes of cylinders (V{=}π r^2 h), cones (V{=}{3}π r^2 h), and spheres (V{=}{3}π r^3). Solve real-world and mathematical problems.

lessons.unit: Unit 6: Associations in Data & Scatter Plots
lessons.title: Patterns of Association
lessons.description: Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate measurement data. Describe patterns of association including clustering, outliers, positive/negative correlation, and linear vs.\ nonlinear trends.

lessons.domain: Associations in Data & Lines of Best Fit
lessons.unit: Unit 6: Associations in Data & Lines of Best Fit
lessons.title: Predictions
lessons.description: Informally fit a straight line to data suggesting a linear association. Interpret slope and intercept in context; use the line of best fit to make predictions and assess model fit.

lessons.title: Two-Way Frequency Tables
lessons.description: Construct and interpret two-way tables summarizing bivariate categorical data from a sample. Use relative frequencies to investigate possible associations between two categorical variables.

lessons.title: Properties of Integer Exponents
lessons.description: Know and apply properties of integer exponents (product, quotient, power, zero, and negative exponent rules) to generate equivalent numerical expressions (e.g., 3^2 3^{-5} = 3^{-3} = {27}).

lessons.title: Scientific Notation & Orders of Magnitude
lessons.description: Express very large and very small quantities in scientific notation. Choose units of appropriate size; compare magnitudes and perform operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) with numbers in scientific notation.

lessons.title: Square & Cube Roots
lessons.description: Use square root and cube root symbols to represent solutions to x^2 = p and x^3 = p. Evaluate roots of perfect squares and cubes; recognize √(2) as irrational and connect to the Pythagorean Theorem.

lessons.title: The Pythagorean Theorem
lessons.description: Explain a proof of the Pythagorean Theorem and its converse. Apply to determine unknown side lengths and classify triangles (right, acute, obtuse) in real-world and mathematical problems.

lessons.title: Distance in the Coordinate Plane
lessons.description: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to find the distance between two points in the coordinate plane. Derive and use the distance formula in real-world contexts.

lessons.title: Rational & Irrational Numbers
lessons.description: Distinguish rational from irrational numbers. Understand that irrational numbers have non-repeating, non-terminating decimal expansions. Use rational approximations of irrationals to compare size and locate on a number line.

lessons.title: Cumulative Real-World Applications
lessons.description: Solve complex, multi-step real-world problems integrating all 8th grade domains: transformations, linear equations, systems, functions, volume, data analysis, exponents, and the Pythagorean Theorem. Communicate mathematical reasoning clearly and justify solutions.
